evidence_required: encapsulation difference (EtherType vs UDP/IP); routed /31 consequence; at least two counter-level signatures.

marking.criterion: Encapsulation: RoCEv1 is EtherType 0x8915 with GRH+BTH and no IP header; RoCEv2 is UDP/IP port 4791
Routed /31 consequence: the leaf cannot route a non-IP frame and drops it
Leaf-side signature (non-IP/unknown-EtherType drops rising, zero DSCP 26/UDP 4791 packets from the port)
Host-side signature (local_ack_timeout_err on both peers, IBV_WC_RETRY_EXC_ERR, no out_of_sequence)

title: RoCEv1 versus RoCEv2
